leadText: Treecko (Japanese: キモリ Kimori) is a Pokémon who appeared in Pokémon Chamo-Chamo ☆ Pretty ♪. He lives with two sisters, Grovyle and Sceptile, and his hobby is stealing the feathers from bird Pokémon.
